Hi Lena / Aisha,

Attached are two items: 1) a short excerpt from Redwood's MSA with our preferred language for Data Processing (Section 6), IP, and Limitation of Liability (Redwood_MSA_excerpt.pdf), and 2) a marked-up SOW where we've annotated where MSA obligations drive delivery timing (EcoSync_SOW_v3_redline.docx).

Summary of key redlines / asks from Redwood Legal:
- Data Processing / DPA: we propose Redwood's DPA text that includes: purpose-limited processing, return/deletion windows (30/90 days depending on logs vs. derived models), and security controls (SOC2 baseline). If EcoSync needs pseudonymization language, include a specific tech spec and re-identification controls.
- IP & Deliverables: Customer retains Customer Data and Outputs. Integration deliverables authored by Redwood will be licensed to EcoSync; for any joint engineering efforts there should be an explicit statement about ownership or a work-for-hire schedule in the SOW.
- Limitation of Liability: we propose a mutual cap equal to 12 months of fees paid under the SOW, with carve-outs for gross negligence and willful misconduct. Redwood cannot accept a unilateral $250k cap; that would be below expected pilot fees.
- Indemnity / Third Party Claims: balanced mutual indemnities with a requirement to cooperate on defense and control of counsel selection for third-party IP claims.

We tried to keep the redlines minimal so we can keep the pilot timeline. Proposed next steps:
1) Procurement call (30 mins) to align on liability cap approach and DPA windows
2) Exchange final markups in DocuSign or shared Drive so commercial can track final SOW values

Attachments: Redwood_MSA_excerpt.pdf (pdf), EcoSync_SOW_v3_redline.docx (docx)

Happy to hop on a call next Wednesday morning PT — Aisha proposed Wed; that works for us.
